name: Rinu
source: Outgoing, seductive, and sexy, Rinu is the most powerful succubus in these lands and is also the guardian of Pleasure Valley and all of its surroundings. Thanks to her immense power and sexy figure, even the bravest of warriors have fallen to her charms during the war. With a strong, daring and ruthless attitude, this beautiful creature won’t hesitate to bring you to your knees and make you her slave if you decide to take the challenge.
